Name: Child Needs You
Author: logNest
Description:
[b]Supported languages: [/b]English (English description below), 简体中文

[size=5][b]Child Needs You 孩子需要你[/b][/size]

现在，你的孩子可能会在一天中的随机时间表达需求：想喝奶，想吃冰淇淋，或者只是想你了。
需求得到满足前，婴幼儿会一直哭。满足需求后，就会重新露出笑容啦～
如果伴侣也在场，还会有相应的反应对话。

每次亲自满足需求，都能增加 25 点孩子好感度；没能满足也不会受到惩罚。

[size=4][b]1.2.0 新增：伴侣帮忙照顾[/b][/size]
伴侣和孩子都在家时，空闲的伴侣会主动帮忙照顾孩子。伴侣照顾不消耗物品，也不增加孩子好感度。

[size=4][b]1.3.0 新增：孩子生病[/b][/size]
孩子有小概率会生病，休息一天后会在次日早晨康复。
你可以给孩子喂能量滋补水或生命药水，伴侣有空时也会帮忙照顾。
喂药可以增加孩子好感。如果你和伴侣都没有照顾，孩子好感会下降。
生病及未照顾时的好感扣减均可在配置中关闭。

可通过 Generic Mod Config Menu 或编辑 [b]config.json[/b] 配置需求出现的概率和哭声音量，以及开关通知、音效、伴侣主动照顾和反应对话。伴侣主动照顾默认开启。

[size=4][b]兼容性[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]LittleNPCs[/b]（已测试 [b]The Farmer's Children[/b]）：孩子长成 NPC 后仍会表达需求，但不会再持续哭泣。[/*]
[*][b]HaveMoreKids[/b][/*]
[/list][b]不支持联机，不兼容多婚模组（可能会默认主配偶来照顾孩子）。[/b]

[size=4][b]安装需求[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]《星露谷物语》1.6.14 或更高版本[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.1.7 或更高版本[/*]
[/list]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] 为可选模组，可用于在游戏内调整设置。

[size=4][b]安装方法[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]安装 SMAPI。[/*]
[*]将 ChildNeedsYou 解压到《星露谷物语》的 [b]Mods[/b] 文件夹中。[/*]
[*]通过 SMAPI 启动游戏。[/*]
[/list]

[line]

[left][size=5][b]English[/b][/size][/left]

Each day, your child may let you know what they need at a random time. They might want some milk, an ice cream, or simply miss you.
Babies and toddlers will keep crying until their needs are met, then start smiling again!
If your spouse is nearby, they'll have something to say, too.

Meeting a need yourself adds 25 friendship points with that child. There is no penalty for leaving a need unmet.

[size=4][b]New in 1.2.0: Spouse care[/b][/size]
When your spouse and child are both at home, your spouse can step in to help if they're free. Spouse care uses no items and doesn't increase friendship with your child.

[size=4][b]New in 1.3.0: Children can get sick[/b][/size]
Your child may occasionally get sick. They rest for the day and recover the next morning.
You can give them an Energy Tonic or Life Elixir, and your spouse can help care for them when free.
Giving medicine increases your child's friendship. If neither you nor your spouse cares for them, their friendship decreases.
Illness and the friendship penalty can each be turned off in the settings.

Use Generic Mod Config Menu or edit [b]config.json[/b] to control how often needs arise and how loud the crying is. You can also toggle notifications, sound effects, spouse care, and spouse reaction dialogue. Spouse care is enabled by default.

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]LittleNPCs[/b] (tested with [b]The Farmer's Children[/b]): Children who grow into NPCs still have needs, but no longer cry.[/*]
[*][b]HaveMoreKids[/b][/*]
[/list][b]Multiplayer and multiple-spouse mods are NOT supported.[/b]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.14 or later[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.1.7 or later[/*]
[/list]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is optional and lets you adjust the settings in-game.

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Extract ChildNeedsYou into your Stardew Valley [b]Mods[/b] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
